# MMC Group - Exhibitions & Events Management Co.

> MMC Group is an exhibitions and events management company based in Cairo, Egypt. It plans and runs events, conferences and exhibitions, from small business meetings to large regional conferences.

## Facts
- Name: MMC Group (Events Management)
- Location: 4 Mohamed Mazloum St., from Hoda Sharawi St., Bab El Louk, Cairo, Egypt
- Phone: +2 (02) 2393 4812
- Email: info@mmc-agency.com
- Website: https://mmcgroup-egy.com/

## Services
Exhibitions and Events; Hotel & Meeting Spaces; Transportation Arrangements; Consulting Services; Event & Social Program; Off-Site Venue Selection; Pre-Event Planning; Budget Planning & Controlling; Media Coverage; Sales & Marketing; Sponsorship Packages & Exposure; On Site Logistics & Support; Travel Arrangements; Hotel Accommodation; Exclusive Tours; Corporate Gifts/Awards.

## Core values
Accountability, Integrity, Reliability, Customer Satisfaction.

## Mission
Reliable, quality-conscious, fast and efficient service that meets and exceeds client expectations.

## Vision
To become a prominent and premier Egyptian reference of event management excellence.
